summary: Crisp Momentum Inc. (filer) filed an 8-K disclosing a Loan Settlement and Share Repurchase Agreement entered on April 20, 2026, with Banji Step K.K. and guarantor Motoko Yorozu. To settle a $2.9M convertible loan and unclosed asset purchases (TopReels and Carpenstream equity), Banji Parties will transfer 80M shares of Crisp common stock back to the Company. No price per share, premium, or advisor is stated; the transaction is a share repurchase via settlement. The mechanics involve forfeiture of retained assets in exchange for stock buyback. Watch for completion of closing conditions and impact on share count.
